profile.subtitleJa: エフライム山地の古代都市
profile.summaryJa: ヨシュア記17:7は、マナセの境界がシェケムの手前を通ると記します。

facts.textJa: シェケムはエフライム山地に置かれた逃れの町として指定された。
レビ人に与えられた町として、逃れの町シェケムが列挙される。
イスラエルの諸部族がシェケムに集まり、神の前に立つ。
ヨシュアはシェケムで民と契約を結ぶ。
エジプトから運び上げられたヨセフの骨がシェケムに葬られたと記される。

profile.modernLocationJa: 古代シェケムは現代ナーブルス東方のテル・バラタ遺跡に同定される。現代都市ナーブルスと古代遺跡は区別する。
profile.historicalRoleJa: マナセ領境界の目印として初出する。
profile.locationNoteJa: 古代の地点と地図上の候補位置との対応は未確定です。地図には従来資料に基づく参考位置を示します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
